item.title: UK GDP grows by 0.3% in June, quarterly growth rate slows
item.summary: In a welcome surprise for the UK economy, GDP growth for June beat expectations, coming in at 0.3% compared to economists’ forecasts of a 0.1% decline. However, quarterly growth dropped to 0.4%, underscoring the economy’s fragility and its inability to fully avoid the impact of the conflict in the Middle East.
